clues.title: A proud woman officer
clues.text: A proud woman officer is shaking hand with her superior.
clues.thought: I have so many to thanks... What should I even say on the podium?

clues.title: Shoulder Insignia of the woman officer
clues.text: A shoulder pad: 1 red stripe in the middle, bearing 1 small star.

clues.title: Shoulder Insignia in the presentation box
clues.text: A velvet-lined presentation box holding a new pair of shoulder pads: 1 red stripe in the middle, bearing 3 small stars.

clues.title: A senior officer
clues.text: A senior officer is shaking hand with the newly promoted officer.
clues.spoken: Congratulations, glad to see my disciple get promoted. A step closer to being a [captain:upper].

clues.title: Shoulder Insignia of the senior officer
clues.text: A shoulder pad: 1 large star in the middle with embroidered oak leaves.

clues.title: The host
clues.text: The host of the ceremony is holding a microphone in one hand and the roster in another.
clues.thought: I haven't flipped a page in my roster yet... This is going to be long...

MVD.cyrillic: Министерство внутренних дел [IPA_ru:mʲɪnʲɪˈsʲtʲɛrstvə vnʉtrʲɪnʲɪx dʲel] (МВД [IPA_ru:ˈɛm ˈvɛ ˈdɛ])
MVD.etiology: Civil Order, Forensic Inquiries, and State Security
MVD.body:
The **Ministry of Internal Affairs ([mvd])** is the state apparatus responsible for maintaining civic order, legal compliance, and criminal investigations across the Russian SFSR and the [ussr].

**Operational Organization:**
Local municipal operations are administered through District Departments of Internal Affairs ([rovd]), while specialized academies and command institutes provide advanced officer training, procedural jurisprudence, and forensic education across the union.

hints.title: Stage 1: Hierarchy Reconstruction
hints.text: Look closely at the conferral table. Can you link the starting and advanced designations across candidates to assemble the complete hierarchy from lowest to highest?

hints.title: Stage 2: Insignia Transition
hints.text: The candidate receiving the honor is transitioning across multiple ranks on her insignia. Which individuals on the list exhibit an accelerated leap in rank?

hints.title: Stage 3: Candidate Disambiguation
hints.text: Only one candidate on the document matches both the honoree's gender and this specific rank leap. Have you inspected the top entries on the roster?
